opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications accepted from not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset and partnerships. Includes charities, trusts, community and voluntary groups, community/parish councils, community interest companies, faith-based or church organisations, local authorities and other public sector organisations.
opportunities.summary: National Lottery Heritage Grants funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage, guided by four investment principles (saving heritage, protecting the environment, inclusion/access/participation, organisational sustainability). No application deadline; decisions within eight weeks.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications accepted from not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations. Includes charities, trusts, community and voluntary groups, community/parish councils, community interest companies, faith-based or church organisations, local authorities and other public sector organisations. Applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest.
opportunities.summary: National Lottery Heritage Grants funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £250,000 to £10million (larger for exceptional projects). Applications go through development and delivery phases, with quarterly application deadlines. Guided by four investment principles. Applicants must submit an Expression of Interest first.
